chunks: And Ṣāliḥ ibn ʿUqbah narrated, saying:
I heard al-ʿAbd al-Ṣāliḥ عليه السلام saying: "It is recommended for a boy to be lively and energetic in his childhood so that he may be forbearing in his adulthood."
ai.seo_question: Why is youthful liveliness in a child considered recommended in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a degree of spiritedness and youthful energy in a boy's early years is considered praiseworthy. It points to a developmental wisdom: healthy expression in childhood can contribute to forbearance and maturity later in life.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4748 - Salih ibn Uqbah narrated that he heard the Righteous Servant (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)) say:
"It is recommended for a boy to be lively and energetic in his childhood so that he may grow to be gentle and patient in his adulthood."
